description: This Java source file defines an immutable implementation of the ModifyFeaturePropertiesLiveCommand interface, representing a command to modify feature properties in a live context within the Eclipse Ditto project. It contains class and method definitions related to executing and constructing this command.

classes.name: ModifyFeaturePropertiesLiveCommandImpl
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the ModifyFeaturePropertiesLiveCommand interface, encapsulating details for modifying feature properties in a live command.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ModifyFeaturePropertiesLiveCommandImpl from a generic Command object, casting to ModifyFeatureProperties.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the feature to be modified.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Returns the FeatureProperties object containing the properties to be modified.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is MODIFY.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new command instance with specified DittoHeaders appended.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates whether this command changes authorization, returning false.

methods.name: answer
methods.description: Returns a builder for creating responses related to this command.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of this command implementation.
